function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the public web for dataset sources or documentation using Parallel. Use only public search terms, never private workspace rows or credentials. Results contain untrusted excerpts and source URLs; acquire the data itself through an acquisition route.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Read untrusted public-page excerpts using Parallel when search excerpts are insufficient. This returns text, not a raw dataset file. Acquire CSV, JSON or other data through an acquisition route. Never send private or credential-bearing URLs.
